Author: pyreymo
Name: Event Horizon
Changelog:
- Reworked keep rules into one sortable order, with each rule configurable as budget-counted or budget-exempt.
- Added a redesigned settings layout with status summaries and a live player preview for visibility state, matched rules, budget status, and nearby range.
- Fixed keep-rule ranking so Nearby distance only breaks ties for the Nearby rule and does not affect unrelated rule matches.
- Changed hiding other players' fashion accessories to be disabled by default.
Description: Cull distant or irrelevant world objects around your character. Use /eventhorizon or /eh to open settings.
